name: e2e-blank-slate-journey
description: End-to-end blank-slate journey validation: a new SG BTO owner drives bare shell -> surfaces -> theme/furnish -> MEP/circuits/aircon -> decision support -> outputs, all in one session. Every stage screenshotted; print docs (drawing set + trade packs) captured into window vars and rendered last (document.write destroys the app).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: (() => { try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {} const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13); s.setUiMode?.('simple'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags?.(); })()

steps.name: open-wizard
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setSmartStartOpen(true)

steps.name: apply-bare-bto
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setSmartStartOpen(false); s.applyBareBto(); return JSON.stringify({ items: s.items.length }); })()

steps.name: report-bare
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); return JSON.stringify({ items: s.items.length, mainBedFloor: s.finishes.floor.mainBedroom, livingFloor: s.finishes.floor.livingDining, mainBedLeaf: s.doors['door-mainBedroom']?.leaf ?? null }); })()

steps.name: set-surfaces
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setFloorFinish('mainBedroom','floor-vinyl'); s.setFloorFinish('bedroom2','floor-vinyl'); s.setFloorFinish('bedroom3','floor-vinyl'); s.setFloorFinish('livingDining','floor-tile-white'); s.setWallFinish('livingDining','wall-fluted-oak'); return 'surfaces-set'; })()

steps.name: set-bath-level
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const rooms = s.floorPlan.rooms; const bath = rooms.find(r => r.category==='bath' || /bath|toilet|wc/i.test(r.name)); if (bath) { s.updateRoom(bath.id, { floorLevelMm: -50 }); return 'bath-level -50 on '+bath.id; } return 'no-bath'; })()

steps.name: report-surfaces
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); return JSON.stringify({ mainBedFloor: s.finishes.floor.mainBedroom, livingFloor: s.finishes.floor.livingDining, livingWall: s.finishes.walls.livingDining }); })()

steps.name: snapshot-finishes-before-theme
steps.eval: (() => { const f = window.__store.getState().finishes; window.__finBefore = JSON.stringify({ mainBed: f.floor.mainBedroom, living: f.floor.livingDining, livingWall: f.walls.livingDining }); return window.__finBefore; })()

steps.name: apply-theme
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.applyLayoutPreset('japandi'); return JSON.stringify({ items: s.items.length }); })()

steps.name: report-theme
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const f = s.finishes; return JSON.stringify({ items: s.items.length, mainBedFloorAfter: f.floor.mainBedroom, livingFloorAfter: f.floor.livingDining, livingWallAfter: f.walls.livingDining, finBefore: window.__finBefore }); })()

steps.name: adjust-one-room
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); const items = s.items; const sofa = items.find(i => /sofa/.test(i.defId)); if (sofa) { s.moveItem?.(sofa.id, [sofa.position[0] + 0.3, sofa.position[1]]); return 'moved '+sofa.defId; } return JSON.stringify({ firstDefs: items.slice(0,5).map(i=>i.defId) }); })()

steps.name: pro-mode
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setUiMode('pro'); s.reresolveFeatureFlags(); })()

steps.name: suggest-mep
steps.eval: (() => { const r = window.__store.getState().suggestMepPoints(); window.__mepCounts = JSON.stringify(r); return window.__mepCounts; })()

steps.name: suggest-circuits
steps.eval: (() => { const r = window.__store.getState().suggestSwitchCircuits(); window.__circCounts = JSON.stringify(r); return window.__circCounts; })()

steps.name: plan-aircon
steps.eval: (() => { const r = window.__store.getState().planAircon(); window.__acCounts = JSON.stringify(r); return window.__acCounts; })()

steps.name: report-systems
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); return JSON.stringify({ elecPts: (s.floorPlan.electricalPoints||[]).length, plumbPts: (s.floorPlan.plumbingPoints||[]).length, fcus: s.items.filter(i=>i.defId==='aircon-unit').length, condensers: s.items.filter(i=>i.defId==='aircon-condenser').length, mep: window.__mepCounts, circ: window.__circCounts, ac: window.__acCounts }); })()

steps.name: open-daylight
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setDaylightOpen(true)

steps.name: scroll-aircon
steps.eval: (() => { const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('.sec-h')].find(e=>/aircon system/i.test(e.textContent)); if (t) t.scrollIntoView({block:'start'}); return t ? 'found' : 'missing'; })()

steps.name: close-daylight
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setDaylightOpen(false)

steps.name: show-mep-in-plan
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setFloorPlanEditing(true)

steps.name: close-plan
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setFloorPlanEditing(false)

steps.name: open-score
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setDesignScoreOpen(true)

steps.name: report-score
steps.eval: (() => { const t = document.body.textContent || ''; const m = t.match(/(\d+)\s*\/\s*100/); return JSON.stringify({ scoreShown: m ? m[0] : 'no-score-token', panelText: (document.querySelector('.panel')?.textContent||'').slice(0,200) }); })()

steps.name: close-score
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setDesignScoreOpen(false)

steps.name: open-checks
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setClearancePanelOpen(true); if (!s.clearanceOn) s.toggleClearance(); })()

steps.name: close-checks
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setClearancePanelOpen(false)

steps.name: set-budget-target
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setBudgetTarget(60000)

steps.name: report-reno-budget
steps.eval: (() => { const t = document.querySelector('.panel.mini.aux')?.textContent || ''; return JSON.stringify({ hasHacking: /hack/i.test(t), hasWaterproof: /waterproof/i.test(t), hasAircon: /aircon/i.test(t), hasNaN: /NaN/.test(t), head: t.slice(0,300) }); })()

steps.name: open-handover
steps.eval: (() => { const s = window.__store.getState(); s.setKeyCollectionDate('2027-07-12'); s.setHandoverOpen(true); })()

steps.name: report-handover
steps.eval: (() => { const t = document.body.textContent||''; return JSON.stringify({ hasCollectionDate: /2027|Collection/i.test(t), hasDLP: /DLP|defect|warranty/i.test(t) }); })()

steps.name: close-handover
steps.eval: window.__store.getState().setHandoverOpen(false)

steps.name: intercept-window-open
steps.eval: window.open = () => ({ document: { write(h) { window.__lastHtml = h }, close() {} }, close() {}, focus() {}, print() {} })

steps.name: capture-drawing-set
steps.eval: (async () => { const { openDrawingSet } = await import('/src/ui/openDrawingSet.ts'); window.__lastHtml = null; await openDrawingSet(); window.__drawingSet = window.__lastHtml; })()

steps.name: capture-trade-packs
steps.eval: (async () => { const { openTradePack } = await import('/src/ui/openTradePack.ts'); window.__packs = {}; for (const id of ['electrician','tiler','aircon']) { window.__lastHtml = null; await openTradePack(id); window.__packs[id] = window.__lastHtml; } })()

steps.name: assert-drawing-connected
steps.eval: (() => { const h = window.__drawingSet; const out = { hasFFL: /FFL|Floor level|floor level/i.test(h), hasWaterproof: /[Ww]aterproofing/.test(h), hasCircuitTag: /S1|Lighting circuit|circuit/i.test(h), hasElectricalSheet: /Electrical plan/i.test(h) }; window.__drawingAsserts = JSON.stringify(out); return window.__drawingAsserts; })()

steps.name: assert-electrician-circuits
steps.eval: (() => { const p = window.__packs.electrician; const excludesCircuits = /no (switching )?schematic|circuits.{0,40}(excluded|not (yet )?(defined|linked))|unlinked/i.test(p); const hasCircuitContent = /S1|circuit|switching/i.test(p); window.__elecAsserts = JSON.stringify({ excludesCircuits, hasCircuitContent }); return window.__elecAsserts; })()

steps.name: render-drawing-set
steps.eval: document.open(); document.write(window.__drawingSet); document.close(); window.scrollTo(0,0);

steps.name: scroll-dim-plan
steps.eval: (() => { const names=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tb-name')]; const el=names.find(n=>/Dimensioned plan/i.test(n.textContent||'')); const sheet=el&&el.closest('.sheet'); if (sheet) sheet.scrollIntoView(); return sheet?'found':'missing'; })()

steps.name: scroll-elec-sheet
steps.eval: (() => { const names=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tb-name')]; const el=names.find(n=>/Electrical plan/i.test(n.textContent||'')); const sheet=el&&el.closest('.sheet'); if (sheet) sheet.scrollIntoView(); return sheet?'found':'missing'; })()

steps.name: render-electrician-pack
steps.eval: document.open(); document.write(window.__packs.electrician); document.close(); window.scrollTo(0,0);
